text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, fosphenytoin sodium is not on the FDA drug shortage list. Corvale East has 19 days on hand, Corvale General has 24 days, and Corvale Lakeside has 19 days at current use. Phenytoin sodium capsule stock varies from 13 to 31 days across sites.

Why (FDA record): One labeled product is manufactured by Sagent Pharmaceuticals at GLAND. Another is relabeled and repacked by A-S Medication Solutions at FEI 1450743. FDA inspected that plant on 2026-08-12 and classified it Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI); the classification was known to FDA on 2026-10-14. The plant has prior VAI inspections in 2009, 2012, 2013, and 2018.

Our position: Current inventory provides a narrow window. No FDA shortage listing exists to trigger allocation programs. The VAI history at the repackager warrants proactive sourcing to avoid a supply gap.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer evaluates and qualifies Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC product for purchase; P&T Committee approves formulary addition.
2. Buyer evaluates and qualifies Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC product for purchase; P&T Committee approves formulary addition.
3. Buyer evaluates and qualifies Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Inc., USA product for purchase; P&T Committee approves formulary addition.
4. Buyer evaluates and qualifies Gland Pharma Limited product for purchase; P&T Committee approves formulary addition.
5. Buyer evaluates and qualifies Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. product for purchase; P&T Committee approves formulary addition.

Not recommended: Delaying new source qualification until inventory falls below 14 days at any site.
